title: How Does Deleveraging Affect Funding Market Liquidity?
authors: Buhui Qiu; Gary Gang Tian; Haijian Zeng
n_adoption_cohorts_note: reg_fund_cohort.dta: 3 deleveraging-event quarters (2015Q2: 2 funds, 2015Q3: 61 funds, 2016Q1: 15 funds); 78 treated structured funds, each treated once; 136 never-deleveraged control funds (99 appear in all three cohorts).
eligible_reason: The underlying variation is a staggered binary absorbing treatment (forced deleveraging of structured funds in three event quarters, never-deleveraged controls), so the design qualifies in principle, as for mnsc.2021.03758 and mnsc.2021.01914. Every reported DiD, however, is a Gormley-Matsa stacked cohort regression (readme: one cohort per deleveraging event, +/-3 quarters, event quarter dropped, cohorts stacked): reg <y> treatedpost post treated <controls> i.cohort i.yq if eventqtr!=1, cluster(masterfundcode) (Replicationcode.do, Tables 8, 9, 10 Panel D, 11). The regressions have no fund FE (a treated dummy plus cohort FE instead), include a post main effect defined at each cohort's event date for control funds, and add lagged time-varying controls (lagavgalpha, lagretnav, laglnsize, laglnfamilysize) in every column. Not a near-miss under 5c, because stacking, the missing unit FE and the post main effect are violations beyond time-varying controls.
design_notes: Two designs. (1) RD around the leverage-trigger threshold (reg_fund_strdaily.dta; Tables 3-7, A3-A6): reghdfe liquidity on treated within spread bandwidths, noabsorb, with lagged outcomes and controls in most columns. Table 3 pre-crash panel regressions with fund and quarter FE but lagged outcome and leverage regressors. (2) Stacked DiD on fund-quarter outcomes (fundflow, stockholdingschange, cashholdingschange, quarterlyfundreturn): Table 8 static (treatedpost), Table 9 dynamic (treated x pre/post event-quarter dummies plus their main effects), Table 10 probit balance check and PSM-defined treatment (treatedpost_psm), Table 11 continuous liquidity-change interactions (deltaoi x post etc.), Table A7 quantile regressions, Table A8 leverage-limit subsample.
estimators_reported: stacked_cohort_did_ols (Gormley-Matsa; cohort and quarter FE, no fund FE)

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked cohort design (cohort FE, no fund FE); post main effect for control funds; lagged time-varying controls (lagavgalpha lagretnav laglnsize laglnfamilysize)
specs.controls: lagavgalpha lagretnav laglnsize laglnfamilysize ld_before_mktcrash stockholdings_beforemktcrash fundfee lnage
specs.notes: Columns 2-4: stockholdingschange, cashholdingschange, quarterlyfundreturn, same specification. An unstacked TWFE (fund + quarter FE, treatedpost only) could be built from the shipped panel but is not reported.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked cohort event study with event-quarter main effects for all funds, no fund FE, lagged time-varying controls
